name: Blur-Free Inconsistency Modeling
definition: A scheme to mitigate multi-view inconsistency from single-image super-resolution models by using a learnable Inconsistency Modeling (IM) module and a Blur Proposal (BP) module to constrain the loss.
summary: Blur-Free Inconsistency Modeling mitigates multi-view artifacts in volumetric reconstruction by simulating view-dependent inconsistencies and using blur proposals to preserve sharp details during optimization.
